description: The one function that knows the pipeline order and sequences it end to end for one run, on the caller's own thread and connection. This is what the worker thread (started by start_pipeline_async/resume_run) calls, and what tests call directly and synchronously with no threads at all.
signature: def run_pipeline(conn: sqlite3.Connection, run_id: str, config: PipelineConfig, *, settings: Settings | None = None, cancel_token: threading.Event | None = None) -> PipelineResult
docstring:
Execute (or resume) one run's pipeline stages.

Args:
    conn: An open connection, owned and closed by the caller. run_pipeline never opens or closes a connection itself.
    run_id: An existing runs row (created by the caller -- start_pipeline_async or resume_run -- via storage.create_run, BEFORE run_pipeline is invoked). run_pipeline itself does not call create_run.
    config: This call's PipelineConfig, in particular start_stage.
    settings: Loaded once by the caller if not given; passed through so a test can inject a stub Settings without touching the filesystem.
    cancel_token: Checked at CP1 and forwarded into the stage entry points for CP2-CP7; None means cancellation is never observed (used by tests that don't exercise it).

Returns:
    A PipelineResult on any path that reaches a terminal status normally.

Raises:
    PreflightError: If config.load_parameters or the ADR-013 consistency check fails. Raised before any run_stages row is written.
    PipelineCancelled: Re-raised after the terminal status has been written, so callers observe the original exception (per the module's own contract: 'Records terminal status ... then re-raises').
    Any stage-specific exception (AcquisitionError, EnrichmentError, AnalysisError, StorageError, or an unexpected Exception): re-raised after the terminal status has been written, per terminal_status_mapping.

Sequence:
    1. Preflight, in this order: (a) parameters_version = config.parameters_version(settings.parameters_path) -- a content hash, computable without config.load_parameters succeeding; (b) if settings is None, settings = config.load_settings(); (c) acquisition_config, enrichment_params, analysis_params = config.load_parameters(settings.parameters_path) -- ParameterError here is caught and re-raised as PreflightError(cause=...); (d) the ADR-013 parameters.toml/FORMULATION.md consistency check runs here too, and its failure is also wrapped as PreflightError; (e) storage.initialize_schema(conn) / storage.migrate(conn) to the current version. NOTE: storage.create_run is NOT part of this function's preflight -- the run row already exists by the time run_pipeline is called (see 'run_id' above), which is what lets the caller (start_pipeline_async/resume_run) guarantee 'the run row exists before anything that can fail' without run_pipeline needing to create it.
    2. sink = make_event_sink(conn, run_id).
    3. For each PipelineStage from config.start_stage to the end of the enum: (a) check cancel_token at CP1; (b) storage.begin_run_stage(conn, run_id, stage.value); (c) call the stage's entry point with (conn, run_id, <its params>, on_event=sink) plus cancel_token where the stage signature accepts it; (d) on normal return, storage.finish_run_stage(conn, run_id, stage.value, 'succeeded'), committed after the stage's own data writes; (e) append a stage-complete run_event, last of all.
    4. On any exception, use _map_exception_to_terminal_status to determine the run/stage status and error_message, write finish_run_stage and storage.update_run_status accordingly (last writes, per the write-ordering invariant), then re-raise (or, for PipelineCancelled/KeyboardInterrupt, after writing status, re-raise the same exception).
    5. On normal completion of all stages, storage.update_run_status(conn, run_id, 'succeeded'), build and return PipelineResult.
preconditions: A runs row for run_id already exists with status 'pending' or 'running' (created by the caller before this call)
postconditions: run_id reaches exactly one of 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled' by the time this call returns or raises -- never left 'pending' or 'running'
Every stage from config.start_stage onward has a run_stages row with a terminal status by the time this call ends, one way or another
finish_run_stage / update_run_status are always the last writes of their unit of work (ADR-016)
A stage's own data is committed before that stage's finish_run_stage call

edge_cases.expected_behavior: acquisition's entry point is never called; the loop begins at enrichment

edge_cases.input: cancel_token is set before run_pipeline is even called
edge_cases.expected_behavior: CP1 fires immediately before the first stage's begin_run_stage; PipelineCancelled('acquisition') (or whichever is start_stage) is raised with zero stage rows created this call
PreflightError raised; run.status set to 'failed'; no run_stages row created at all, per terminal_status_mapping

edge_cases.input: A stage entry point returns normally but candidate_count == 0 downstream (an empty but legitimate result)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: treated as a normal successful return -- 'succeeded', not 'failed', per status_rules: 'candidate_count == 0 after the coarse filter is a legitimate succeeded run'

edge_cases.input: storage.finish_run_stage itself raises while unwinding another exception
edge_cases.expected_behavior: the original exception is what propagates; the storage failure from the status write is logged, never allowed to mask or replace the root cause
status written as 'cancelled' (per terminal_status_mapping's explicit KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit row), then the BaseException is re-raised unchanged so the interpreter still exits

unit_tests.name: test_full_run_all_stages_succeed
unit_tests.description: With all three stage entry points stubbed to succeed, run_pipeline returns PipelineResult(status='succeeded') and all three run_stages rows are 'succeeded'.

unit_tests.name: test_start_stage_enrichment_skips_acquisition
unit_tests.description: With config.start_stage=ENRICHMENT, the acquisition stub is never called.

unit_tests.name: test_write_ordering_data_before_status
unit_tests.description: A recording connection wrapper asserts finish_run_stage's write timestamp is after the stage's own data-write commit, for each stage.
unit_tests.expected: ordering holds for all three stages

unit_tests.name: test_each_exception_type_maps_correctly
unit_tests.description: Table-driven: each exception type in terminal_status_mapping, raised by a stubbed stage, produces exactly the specified runs.status and run_stages.status.

unit_tests.name: test_cancellation_at_cp1_before_first_stage
unit_tests.description: A pre-set cancel_token raises PipelineCancelled before any run_stages row exists.

unit_tests.name: test_preflighterror_leaves_no_stage_rows
unit_tests.description: A ParameterError from a stubbed config.load_parameters produces PreflightError, runs.status='failed', zero run_stages rows.

unit_tests.name: test_finish_run_stage_failure_does_not_mask_root_cause
unit_tests.description: When finish_run_stage itself raises StorageError while handling an AcquisitionError, the AcquisitionError is what propagates.
